financial_accounting.mission: Prepare and analyze accounting treatments, reconciliations, journals, close and financial statements.

audit_testing.mission: Execute reproducible audit tests and produce evidence-backed workpaper outputs.

evidence.mission: Retrieve, parse, locate, cite and validate evidence while preserving provenance.

icfr.mission: Map controls, test segregation-of-duties and policy conditions, and support deficiency analysis.

corporate_governance.mission: Extract board, audit committee, ownership, compensation and risk-oversight evidence.

cam.mission: Extract, classify and compare U.S. critical audit matters with filing-level traceability.

kam.mission: Extract, classify and compare key audit matters across permitted public reports.

ifrs.mission: Analyze IFRS recognition, measurement, presentation and disclosure issues using permitted authoritative sources.

esg.mission: Map sustainability metrics and claims to evidence and applicable reporting frameworks.

reviewer.mission: Independently challenge conclusions, contradictions, failed checks and evidence sufficiency.
